mia: heads-up — after last night's rollout i'm seeing KV prefix hit-rate regressions on a couple model variants. traces show more misses for short prompts (<64 tokens).
josh: where did this start showing up? metrics dashboard or request traces?
mia: both. kv_hit_rate by prompt_length: 83% -> 57% for <64 buckets, timeline aligns with kernel selector swap at 03:12 UTC. profiling points at key construction differences after tokenizer change.
rachel: which tokenizer change? the normalize() edge-case we merged yesterday? cc @josh @sam
mia: looks like it. old key was:
```
key = (model_id, prompt[:64].strip().lower())
```
new key (post-patch) effectively becomes:
```
key = (model_id, prompt.normalize()[:64])
```
normalize() changes whitespace+unicode which shifted many short prompts so cache prefixes no longer matched stored entries.
josh: ack. i flipped kernel selector back for canary at 03:26 and routed traffic to previous variant. hit-rate climbed back to ~81% within 5m.
mia: good rollback. proposal for next steps:
- add a deploy-time prewarm job that emits top-10 prefixes per model variant immediately after rollout
- hook autoscaler events (scale up/down) to trigger a lightweight synthetic prefill so autoscale spikes don't see cold-cache thundering
- add a unit/regression test around "key stability" on tokenizer changes
Suggested cron/runner snippet for deploy prewarm:
```
# run on deploy completion
POST /internal/prewarm
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-2p-small",
  "prefixes": ["what is", "summarize:", "translate to fr:", ...],
  "samples_per_prefix": 3
}
```
Implementation detail: runner should use small batch sizes and the same runtime path as production inference so KV population matches production keying.
sam: SGTM. two caveats: (1) synthetic traffic should vary prompt lengths and token boundaries to exercise short/long prefix buckets, (2) add a canary gating rule: if post-deploy hit-rate delta > 10% fail rollout and auto-rollback.
deploy-bot: rollback executed by @josh at 2024-06-05T03:26:14Z :information_source:
mia: i'll open a short RFC + PR to (a) revert the normalization in tokenizer for keying-stable path, (b) add key-stability unit tests, (c) add the deploy prewarm job + autoscaler hook skeleton. will include hit-rate dashboard links and expected thresholds.
rachel: also propose we collect per-prefix cardinality and entropy metrics. if a prefix has high-cardinality we avoid prewarms for it or use rate-limited seeding. avoids evicting useful low-entropy prefixes.
josh: :thumbsup: i'll add the canary alert and the autoscaler prewarm hook. plan to run a one-off scheduled prewarm across canary region tonight at 22:00 to validate.
mia: thanks — will post RFC link once draft is up.
